Here’s a tailored **proposal draft** you can send to **VIO Med Spa owners (Joe, Ryan, and Anthony)** about securing a discounted group licensing deal for the **Aesthetic Injector Academy (AIA) Full Curriculum**:  

---

## **Partnership Proposal: Aesthetic Injector Academy x VIO Med Spa**

**Presented by:**  
**Elizabeth (Bethany) Gifford**  
Founder, *New Era Intel*  
On behalf of *Aesthetic Injector Academy (AIA)*  

---

### **Objective**
To provide VIO Med Spa’s clinical team with world-class injector education, continuing medical education (CME) credits, and long-term skill development—elevating VIO’s reputation as an industry leader in training, retention, and patient outcomes.

---

### **Proposed Partnership**

We’re extending a **special 50% partnership rate** on the **AIA Full Curriculum** exclusively for VIO Med Spa’s injector team.

- **Retail Value:** $3,250 per injector  
- **Partner Rate:** **$2,437.50 per enrollment**  
- **Discount:** 50% off  
- **Licenses:** 30+ (one per injector, single-use only)  
- **Enrollment Window:** 6 months  
- **CE Credits:** 20 hours approved by state medical boards  
- **Certification:** Individual Certificate of Completion from AIA  

---

### **What Each Injector Receives**

✅ **Full Access to AIA’s Complete Curriculum**
A comprehensive, evidence-based education in facial anatomy, safety, injection technique, and aesthetic artistry.

✅ **20 CE Hours**
Fully accredited through the state medical board—ensuring every injector gains legitimate professional credit for their advancement.

✅ **Certificate of Completion**
Awarded individually, enhancing each injector’s portfolio, credibility, and value within your organization.

✅ **Exclusive Learning Platform Access**
Each injector will receive personal login credentials for AIA’s full video library and course content.  
• Access valid for **6 months post-completion**  
• Additional third-party manufacturer modules (coming soon) available for **up to 1 year**

---

### **Strategic Value for VIO Med Spa**

**1. Staff Retention & Loyalty**  
Providing CE-backed injector training demonstrates deep investment in your team’s growth. It builds loyalty, pride, and long-term retention—your injectors will feel valued and invested in as professionals.

**2. Elevated Brand Perception**  
Clients are drawn to practices that prioritize safety, education, and excellence. Having “AIA-Certified Injectors” strengthens your brand’s credibility and positions VIO as a national benchmark in clinical standards.

**3. Operational Consistency**  
Standardized training ensures every injector, regardless of experience level, adheres to the same high standard of care, technique, and communication—creating a seamless patient experience across all locations.

**4. Recruitment Advantage**  
Offering accredited injector education as part of your employment benefits makes VIO a magnet for top talent in the aesthetic space.

---

### **Partnership Vision**

Our goal is not just a transaction—it’s the start of a long-term relationship. We see this collaboration as the foundation of an ongoing alliance between **AIA and VIO**, focused on education, excellence, and empowerment.  

Bethany and the AIA leadership would be honored to be part of the **VIO family**, supporting your mission to cultivate exceptional injector talent nationwide. As the partnership expands, we can explore co-branded training events, in-person workshops, and manufacturer collaborations tailored for VIO’s team.

---

### **Next Steps**

1. Confirm interest in proceeding with the 30+ license group rate.  
2. AIA will issue a custom **enrollment code** for VIO Med Spa.  
3. Each injector will receive:
   - Their unique code (valid for 6 months)  
   - Enrollment instructions  
   - Login credentials upon activation  

---

**Presented with appreciation,**  
**Bethany Gifford**  
New Era Intel, on behalf of Aesthetic Injector Academy  
📧 bethany@neweraintel.com  
🌐 [www.neweraintel.com](https://www.neweraintel.com)  
🔗 [LinkedIn: Bethany Gifford](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bethany-gifford)

---
